description:
You are an Electrical Designer. Update the building's Single Line Diagram (SLD) to include a new EV charging station distribution panel.

1. Review the engineering specifications in '~/Desktop/project_memo_ev_expansion.txt'.
2. Open the existing diagram '~/Diagrams/building_4_sld.drawio'.
3. Modify the diagram to add:
   - A new 200A 3-Pole breaker on the Main Switchboard (MSB).
   - A new Distribution Panel labeled 'DP-EV'.
   - A feeder connection from the MSB to DP-EV.
   - Text annotations for the feeder wire size and panel ratings exactly as specified in the memo.
4. Save the diagram.
5. Export the final diagram as a PDF to '~/Diagrams/exports/building_4_sld_updated.pdf'.

Note: If an update dialog appears on startup, dismiss it.
